lines.say: A grocery store in Connecticut put a three ton rock at its front door.
caps: *three ton rock* at the front door.

lines.say: Two rules were carved into it. Number one, the customer is always right.
The second one said, if the customer's ever wrong, go back and read number one.
That store sold five times as much per square foot as a normal grocery store. Guinness noticed.
caps: *Five times* the sales per square foot

lines.say: Nobody owes you a return visit. So text him. Been a while, anything I could've done better?
Comment KEEP and we'll show you who's gone quiet.
